SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) m, channel_code, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, sum(gross_amount) g, min(etl_loaded_at) e0, max(etl_loaded_at) e1
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT w.status, date_trunc('month', CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) disp_m, date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) sale_m, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-10-10'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.store_id<>900 AND s.store_id<>999 AS physical, s.store_id=999 AS tr, p.category='ZZ Test' AS test, f.channel_code, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)-f.gross_amount) diff, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) bad_store_ver, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) bad_prod_ver
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
           s.region, f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS gross_sales_incl_vat_aug_2024,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS gross_sales_incl_vat_sep_2024,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE business_date IS NULL) null_dates
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' OR business_date IS NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
mine AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT m.mon, m.store_id=900 AS web, m.mine, r.ctrl, m.mine - r.ctrl AS diff FROM
 (SELECT date_trunc('month', d) mon, store_id, sum(net_amount) mine FROM mine WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2) m
JOIN (SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) mon, store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) ctrl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2) r
 ON r.mon=m.mon AND r.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE abs(m.mine-r.ctrl) > 0.5 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN sale_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
 count(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END) mon,
  CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 'store999' WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 'zz_test_other' ELSE 'kept' END grp, sum(f.gross_amount) g, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
